projectContext: Sprint 18 targets untested scoring functions in src/matching/scoring.py and src/matching/metrics.py. Previous sprints established strong coverage for duration, topic, B-roll, caption quality, and entity match scoring. This sprint focuses on the remaining 8 untested functions: temporal coherence (compute_temporal_coherence, _is_jarring_context_switch), transcript quality (calculate_transcript_quality, _calculate_sentence_coherence, _calculate_language_consistency), embedding weight adjustment (adjust_embedding_weight_for_transcript_quality), semantic coherence (compute_semantic_coherence), pool normalization (normalize_confidence_by_pool), and metrics histogram (log_confidence_histogram). These functions represent ~400 LOC of untested confidence calibration logic that directly affects match quality output.
